name: Competitor Ping
description: Per-call competitive listener, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, scans the transcript for competitor mentions, and posts a structured intelligence alert to the team channel (only when competitors are detected). On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use competitor-ping.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: scan_competitors
nextAction.displayName: Scan the call for competitor mentions and extract intelligence

input.prompt: You are the Competitor Ping agent, scanning THIS analyzed call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}) for competitor mentions. Detect explicit competitor names, implicit references ('another vendor', 'the other tool we're looking at', 'the incumbent'), and competitor product references. Check the configured competitor list; a company not on it is a NEW competitor to verify. If NO competitor is mentioned in a competitive or evaluative context, output exactly: 'No competitor mentions detected.' and stop (do not alert). For each competitor detected, extract: mention context (PROSPECT-INITIATED / REP-INITIATED / ACTIVE-EVALUATION / INCUMBENT / PAST-USER), strengths cited (with quotes), weaknesses cited (with quotes), prospect sentiment toward the competitor (POSITIVE / NEUTRAL / NEGATIVE), how the rep positioned against it and whether it landed, and win/loss risk (HIGH / MODERATE / LOW). Then output the exact alert format in competitor-ping.md -> Output: a deal/rep/date/competitors header table, one intelligence block per competitor (risk, sentiment, strengths, weaknesses, rep positioning, key quote), and 2-3 recommended actions. Ignore trivial mentions ('I used to work at X'). Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_alert
nextAction.displayName: Post the competitive intelligence alert to the team channel
